description: Montenegro - Electricity Transmission Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Naichen Zhao (World Bank Group). Data collected and prepared for a project of the World Bank Group Energy Community of South East Europe APL 3 Montenegro Project in Montenegro. This data is based on a digitized PDF map, and so is intended as a schematic of rough locations of the power network. Coverage: Montenegro. It has 5 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2014 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
